# Machin Nursery Farms

Updated: 2026-11-12
Website: https://www.machinnurseryfarms.com/

A plant nursery in Homestead, Florida, serving retail and wholesale enquiries from homeowners, landscapers and contractors. The published catalogue includes Clusia, Podocarpus, Cocoplum, tropical accents and ornamental trees. The site is available in English and Spanish.

## Pages
- Home: https://www.machinnurseryfarms.com/
- Plants: https://www.machinnurseryfarms.com/plants.html
- Services: https://www.machinnurseryfarms.com/services.html
- Gallery: https://www.machinnurseryfarms.com/gallery.html
- Contact: https://www.machinnurseryfarms.com/contact.html
- About: https://www.machinnurseryfarms.com/about.html
- Spanish: https://www.machinnurseryfarms.com/es/

## Purchase information

The website does not publish live stock or prices. Enquiries should specify species, pot or plant size, quantity, city and preferred date. Delivery, installation, fees, minimum orders and dates require direct confirmation.
